# semaphore_ex_global_role (Resource)

Manages a custom Semaphore EX role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "semaphore_ex_global_role" "auditor" {
  name                = "Auditor"
  project_permissions = []
  global_permissions  = ["global.audit.read"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `global_permissions` (Set of String) Named global permissions from the server catalog.
- `name` (String) Role display name.
- `project_permissions` (Set of String) Named project permissions from the server catalog.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-generated opaque role ID.
- `revision` (Number) Server revision for optimistic concurrency control.
- `slug` (String) Server-generated role slug.
